description: C++ inference engine behind an OpenAI-compatible API, running inside Lemonade on AMD Ryzen AI: the XDNA 2 NPU, HRX on the iGPU, ZINC for NVIDIA and Apple GPUs, MLX on Apple.
rules: Serve models with `1bit serve`; it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and runs as Lemonade's `onebit` backend.

Pick the device with `--device` (auto, npu, hrx, cpu, zinc, ds4, mlx, onnx); an NPU model directory runs on the NPU fast lane, and `auto` runs plain GGUF files on HRX. The engine has no Vulkan or ROCm build: Lemonade's own llamacpp backend serves those.
Prefer Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs: UD-Q4_K_XL is the lean default, UD-Q5_K_XL the accurate choice.
For one user at a time use `--mtp`; for many simultaneous requests use `--parallel`.
Documentation lives at https://1bit.gg; measured results are on the GitHub wiki.
